name: Learning Activity / Course Delivery
publication_holds: Codex single-provider fallback research: Claude Sonnet and Grok 4.6 each timed out on their one bounded 120-second attempt for WM-ACT-038. No external provider result was admitted. The source-grounded Codex fallback passed local schema validation and the required separate no-tools adversarial audit. The result remains reviewable-draft pending independent review or explicit owner authorization for canonical promotion, and this hold must remain visible.

Specification-version verification required before final promotion: Edu-API is Candidate Final Public (not released); Common Cartridge 1.4 is Candidate Final. Accept for draft and peer review; final release requires conformance to final-version standards or explicit specification-level hold declaration in publication artifacts.

Schema-level enforcement of inference safeguards deferred: policy forbids collapsing login into attendance, activity into learning, score into mastery, completion into credit. Data model currently lacks technical constraints (required evidence-method fields, confidence markers, forbidden-inference rules). Publication hold pending schema-level additions that make these distinctions machine-auditable and prevent silent consumer collapse.

Interoperability round-trip not proven: mappings among ISCED, ELM, Edu-API, OneRoster, Caliper, CASE, QTI, xAPI, CLR and CourseInstance are listed as intentional but proposed relations or mapping versions remain held for review. No working mapping tables, version-pair conflict rules or bidirectional validation were supplied. Hold pending approved mapping specifications with identified omissions and conflict resolution.

Regional legal and accessibility variance requires education-sector specialist review: model explicitly acknowledges jurisdiction variation (FERPA, GDPR, UK Records Act, national retention, consent, learner-rights, child protection, intellectual property, credential authority) and regional context assumptions (K-12 vs. higher-education vs. vocational vs. workplace vs. community vs. informal). Known omissions state this review is required before canonical promotion. Hold pending education-sector audit, accessibility conformance assessment, child-protection governance mapping and jurisdiction-specific policy coverage.
Independent external review was explicitly waived by the repository owner; this codex-only result remains a reviewable draft.
